**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "The UK's best loose leaf tea" | Unsupported. Superlative the policy bans ("best"). |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted ("Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). |
| "certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted (certificate renewed 2026). |
| "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted. |

**Other problems**
- The packed-by-hand claim appears twice in three sentences. Redundant, so cut one (the sharper one is the second).
- No ban-list words or structural slop found otherwise.

**Suggested rewrite**

Loose leaf tea from Bristol, with every tin packed by hand and certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

The landing page and any ad using this copy should make the same claims, and all are on the allowlist. Sam needs to approve before publishing.

**Verdict:** Do not publish as is. Remove "The UK's best".
